title: Performance Budget Compiler
description: Compiles performance budgets for Core Web Vitals, bundle sizes, and Lighthouse scores. Enforces: INP not FID (FID deprecated 2024), CLS is decimal not integer, ciAction enforced, Lighthouse runs ≥3 for statistical reliability, per-route budgets reference real routes.

error_codes.QA030: performance-budget-spec.json missing or invalid — required: coreWebVitals, ciAction
error_codes.QA031: FID (First Input Delay) declared — FID was deprecated in 2024, use INP (Interaction to Next Paint) instead
error_codes.QA032: CLS threshold is integer (≥1) — CLS is a score between 0 and 0.25, not milliseconds
error_codes.QA034: ciAction is 'none' or missing — performance budget defined but never enforced
error_codes.QA035: Lighthouse numberOfRuns < 3 — single-run Lighthouse scores have high variance
